dogecoin.text: We just spent about 7-8 years' worth of the Pentagon defense budgets on COVID stimulus. About 50% of it went into Gamestop stock, Dogecoin, and NFTs.

The way we talk about bubbles like 'DogeCoin Rallied' as if the thing itself rallied, is a big part of how bubbles inflate. This instead of 'people plowing new money into DogeCoin.'

When this pops and ppl lose real money, the govt needs to disappear Elon, Jack Ma style. https://t.co/12a2xhz3iy

Many misconceptions, for example, that b/c market cap of Dogecoin is ~$80 billion, that means people have plowed $80 billion into Dogecoin.

No, $80 billion = total # of Dogecoin x price paid for the last Dogecoin sale.

This gives a very different, and much lower number.
